tools.name: write_listing_description
tools.description: Write an MLS-ready real estate listing (headline, 120-180 word description, social caption) from property facts, in English, Korean or Spanish. Fair-Housing-safe wording (describes the property, never the ideal buyer; 'primary bedroom' not 'master'). Does not invent facts. Free: 3 per day. Unlimited

tools.name: check_fair_housing_wording
tools.description: Flag common US Fair Housing red-flag phrases in listing copy (e.g. 'perfect for families', 'adults only', 'master bedroom') and return a cleaned version. Rule-based, free, unlimited. Not legal advice.
